tbesh_html:
1) to envy, be jealous, be envious, be zealous
1a) (Piel)
1a1) to be jealous of
1a2) to be envious of
1a3) to be zealous for
1a4) to excite to jealous anger
1b) (Hiphil) to provoke to jealous anger, cause jealousy

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to be (causatively, make) zealous, i.e. (in a bad sense) jealous or envious
strongs_1890.kjv_def: (be) envy(-ious), be (move to, provoke to) jealous(-y), [idiom] very, (be) zeal(-ous).
